day_shape: 97 items: IDF says it killed senior Hamas General Security Apparatus figures including deputy head Hassan Labad, UNIFIL peacekeeper killed by mortars IDF attributes to Hezbollah, Aoun says US-brokered Lebanon ceasefire could take effect within 24 hours, heavy Khamenei/Ghadir messaging cycle.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Hamas security apparatus
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said overnight air and naval strikes in Gaza killed senior figures in Hamas's General Security Apparatus, which protects Hamas leadership. Those named killed include deputy head Hassan Rabah Hassan Labad, Asim Shubair, Abdullah Abu Kalou and Mohammed Abu Marek.

threads.label: UNIFIL peacekeeper killed in south Lebanon
threads.summary: UNIFIL said a peacekeeper was killed and two wounded by mortars striking its position near Marjayoun overnight, with the IDF attributing the launches to Hezbollah from the Qotrani area. The IDF separately reported Hezbollah rocket and FPV drone fire at troops and at Northern Command chief Maj. Gen. Rafi Milo's convoy.

threads.label: Lebanon ceasefire diplomacy and Iranian pushback
threads.summary: Lebanese President Aoun said a US-brokered Israel-Lebanon ceasefire could take effect within 24 hours pending approval, with the Jerusalem Post reporting Hezbollah had rejected the agreed plan. Quds Force chief Qaani demanded Israel return to pre-conflict positions, and the IRGC issued a statement telling Israel to withdraw from Lebanon.

threads.label: Israeli strikes on southern Lebanese towns
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB said Israeli airstrikes hit residential areas in Tyre and the towns of An-Nabatiyya al-Fawqa, Toul, Touline and Qabrisha. The IDF separately said troops killed a Hezbollah operative north of the Litani and uncovered a weapons store including a surface-to-air missile.

threads.label: Khamenei Khomeini-anniversary messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released a stream of Telegram posts marking the 37th anniversary of Khomeini's death, claiming the enemy, after military defeat, is targeting popular resilience and officials' "computational system" via hybrid warfare. IRIB and Defa Press amplified the message alongside Ghadir Day rallies in Tehran, Birjand and Isfahan.

threads.label: US Iran posture: CENTCOM blockade, ICBM letter
threads.summary: CENTCOM posted that as of 4 June US forces had redirected 127 commercial vessels, disabled 6 non-compliant ships and let 36 humanitarian vessels pass under what it called a US blockade against Iran. The Jerusalem Post reported Iranian officials had sent Mojtaba Khamenei a letter demanding the Islamic Republic begin developing ICBMs.

threads.label: Iran domestic: WHO aid, shortages, hardliners
threads.summary: WHO announced a US$2 million emergency project with Iran's Health Ministry to prevent disease outbreaks and sustain essential health services. Iran International reported shortages of addiction medicines, alleged use of children in security activities, and the sidelining of Paydari Front supporters from pro-government nightly rallies.

events.title_en: Urgent warning to residents of southern Lebanon!
events.summary_en: Urgent warning to residents of southern Lebanon! Fighting in southern Lebanon continues as the Israeli Defence Force continues to target Hezbollah facilities and infrastructure located in and near your villages. The Defence Force does not intend to harm you. For your safety, refrain from heading south of the Litani River until further notice! Anyone heading south puts their life at risk.
